newsitem.title: MEXICO: Nissan to build Sentras in Mexico only.
newsitem.headline: Nissan to build Sentras in Mexico only.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd in 1999 will base worldwide production of its Sentra model sedans at its plant in the north-central Mexican city of Aguascalientes, the Japanese ambassador to Mexico said on Tuesday.

"In the year 1999, the Nissan brand Sentra will be produced at the plant in Aguascalientes," the ambassador, Terusuke Terada, told Reuters after a tour of the plant. "Starting in the 21st century, we (in Japan) will have to import the cars produced here."
Nissan currently produces Sentras and two other models at plants in Aguascalientes and Cuernavaca just south of Mexico City.

Noting that Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto promised $950 million in aid to Mexico during his recent visit there, the ambassador said his country would continue to invest with confidence in Mexico.
About two-thirds of direct Japanese investment in Mexico goes to the state of Aguascalientes, Terada said. He said Japanese banks might soon open branches in Aguascalientes.
